Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Ceramic Table Lamp, 18"H, Crackle Dark Blue
Colors: Crackle Dark Blue
Materials: ceramic
The intricate ceramic pattern with a tone-on-tone blue-crackle glaze finish gives this lamp a true artisanal flair that blends with a variety of styles and decor. 8.5"W x 8.5"D x 17.5"H Dark-blue glossed crackle glazed ceramic base; brushed-nickel accents; off-white linen drum shade This bold ceramic lamp is paired with an off-white linen drum shade to cast perfect ambient light. Includes 1 60-watt equivalent LED bulb included
